sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Current: 3 greens, 2 walls, player at cols 15-16
# Strategy: remove all greens, then move RIGHT step by step, checking for level completion
seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Start: greens={len(greens)}")

# Remove all current greens
for g in greens:
    gc = [p[1] for p in g['boundary']]
    gr = [p[0] for p in g['boundary']]
    center_r = (min(gr) + max(gr)) // 2
    center_c = (min(gc) + max(gc)) // 2
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    remaining = len([n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N'])
    print(f"Removed: remaining={remaining}")

# Now move RIGHT step by step
print("\nMoving RIGHT...")
for i in range(6):
    result = action(['RIGHT'])
    done = result.get('level_completed') or result.get('done') or result.get('game_over')
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    player = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
    pc = [p[1] for p in player['boundary']]
    greens = len([n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N'])
    walls = len([n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'S'])
    print(f"RIGHT #{i+1}: player={min(pc)}-{max(pc)}, greens={greens}, walls={walls}, done={done}")
    if done:
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED or GAME OVER!")
        break
    # If greens appear, remove them
    if greens > 0:
        greens_list = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
        for g in greens_list:
            gc = [p[1] for p in g['boundary']]
            gr = [p[0] for p in g['boundary']]
            center_r = (min(gr) + max(gr)) // 2
            center_c = (min(gc) + max(gc)) // 2
            result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        remaining = len([n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N'])
        print(f"  Removed greens: remaining={remaining}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
